tips.text: Keep a Death Mark on you and play normal missions; he tends to show up once you stop hunting him.
Run a full squad where everyone holds a Death Mark; each marked player raises the spawn chance.
Kill the Hyena Pack in Psamathe, Neptune; each Hyena gives its own mark, so one solo run stacks several.
Re-arm on The Sergeant in Iliad, Phobos; Volt with Shocking Speed, Gauss or Titania clear it fastest.
Let each mission run four to five minutes (Defense, Survival, relic runs) instead of blitzing, so he has time to spawn.
Spend Stalker Beacons on this farm; players hunting his other drops report getting mostly Dreads.
Stay at range and stop shooting when he casts Absorb.
Restart the mission around the 280-second mark if he has not spawned.
Keep the marked player alive; if they go down he despawns with no drop, even after a revive.
Pick a different mission when Grustrag Three or Zanuka Hunter is set for it; a Stalker cannot join those.
Expect Dread within a few encounters with a mark active; it is the Stalker's most common drop.
